The '''sunpetal''' was a [[Plant/Legends|flower]] native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Timora]]. [[Wanda Windrow]], a correspondent for ''[[Galactic Resorts]]'', wrote a [[NewsNet]] article on their suitability as a gift.
